sentences.en: Public feeling against air pollution has at last became vocal.
sentences.zh: 公众对空气污染的不满终于有了声音。

sentences.en: Vowels use the vocal chords and consonants use the mouth.
sentences.zh: 元音使用声带，辅音使用口腔。

sentences.en: Algeria is a vocal critic of the state of Israel.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚是以色列国家状态的一个直言不讳的批评者。

collocations.zh: 声乐；通过口头传唱的音乐
